categories.name: Sorting Algorithms
categories.description: Visualizations of comparison and non-comparison sorting algorithms.

categories.name: Pathfinding
categories.description: Bidirectional searches on interactive obstacle grids.

categories.name: Graph Algorithms
categories.description: Shortest paths and connected components on draggable weighted graphs.

bubble-sort.name: Bubble Sort
bubble-sort.description: Repeatedly compares and swaps adjacent out-of-order values.

selection-sort.name: Selection Sort
selection-sort.description: Repeatedly selects the smallest remaining value.

insertion-sort.name: Insertion Sort
insertion-sort.description: Builds a sorted prefix by inserting each next value.

merge-sort.name: Merge Sort
merge-sort.description: Recursively splits and merges sorted halves.

heap-sort.name: Heap Sort
heap-sort.description: Uses a heap to repeatedly extract the largest value.

bfs-path.name: Breadth-First Search (BFS)
bfs-path.description: Two FIFO frontiers expand level by level and produce a shortest path on this unweighted grid.

dfs-path.name: Depth-First Search (DFS)
dfs-path.description: Two LIFO frontiers explore deeply until they connect; the valid path is not necessarily shortest.

dijkstra-path.name: Dijkstra's Algorithm
dijkstra-path.description: Bidirectional uniform-cost search; on the unit-weight grid it returns a shortest path.

singly-linked-list.name: Singly Linked List
singly-linked-list.description: A sequence of nodes linked by next pointers.

binary-search-tree.name: Binary Search Tree (BST)
binary-search-tree.description: A tree with lesser keys left and greater keys right.

graph-dijkstra.name: Dijkstra (Weighted Graph)
graph-dijkstra.description: Computes shortest paths using Euclidean-distance edge weights that update when nodes move.

graph-weakly-connected.name: Weakly Connected Components
graph-weakly-connected.description: Finds components while treating directed edges as undirected.

binary-search.name: Binary Search
binary-search.description: Locates a target in a sorted array by repeatedly halving the interval.

linear-search.name: Linear Search
linear-search.description: Checks each array element in order until the target is found or the array ends.

fibonacci-tree.name: Fibonacci Recursion Tree
fibonacci-tree.description: Shows the recursive calls of naive Fibonacci evaluation.

turing-machine.name: Turing Machine
turing-machine.description: Visualizes a tape machine incrementing a binary number.
